question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

It can be easy to ignore people who are **__struggling__** and having a hard time.
solution:
The correct answer is "hustling."

***__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• The word **"****struggling****"** means to try very hard to do something, especially when it is difficult. (कोई (विशेषतः कठिन) काम करने के लिए कठोर प्रयास करना)

 
 
• Example: She was **struggling**__ very hard.*
 
 
 
• The appropriate synonym for the underlined word is "hustling."
 
• The word "hustling" means to push or move somebody in a way that is not gentle, trying very hard. (रूखेपन से किसी को धक्‍का देना या रास्‍ते से हटा देना; धकेलना, धकियाना)
 __
 
• Example: *After finishing his regular job, Mark spent his evenings **hustling**__ to launch his own small business.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Booming: **to make a loud deep sound. (धड़ाका होना, दनदनाना, गरजना)
 
• **Claiming: **to say that something is true, without having any proof. (बिना प्रमाण प्रस्‍तुत किए सत्‍यता का दावा करना)
 
• **Gliding: **to move smoothly without noise or effort. (बिना बोले या प्रयास किए कोमलता से सरकना या फिसलना)
